name: agy-supervised-development
description: Codex-supervised development with pre-implementation Sol High plan review, AGY as the primary writer, and Codex-owned review/runtime verification.

interface.shortDescription: Codex plans and proves; Sol High critiques plans; AGY builds.
interface.longDescription: A serial supervised-development workflow. Codex owns Shape/Spec/Slice and the executable plan; GPT-5.6 Sol High may review that plan for up to three rounds before PLAN FROZEN; AGY implements the frozen plan; Codex independently reviews and verifies repository/runtime evidence before acceptance.
capabilities: Shape, specify, and slice executable plans
Review executable plans with GPT-5.6 Sol High before implementation
Delegate bounded execution units to AGY
Run Three-Axis Review and independent verification
Use Chrome DevTools MCP for applicable browser runtime verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development. Build a Codex-owned executable plan, use the default Sol High plan review gate unless I explicitly opt out, freeze the plan, then delegate to AGY and keep post-implementation review and verification Codex-owned.
